title: Traffic light cycle
prompt: A traffic light repeats this cycle forever: green for 3 seconds, then yellow for 1 second, then red for 2 seconds (6 seconds per cycle). At second 0 the light has just turned green, so second 0 is the first second of green and second 3 is the first second of yellow. For each second from 0 to 14 inclusive, print the color shown during that second (`green`, `yellow` or `red`, lowercase), one per line.
expected_output:
green
green
green
yellow
red
red
green
green
green
yellow
red
red
green
green
green
